record.excerpt: If the D1 MACD line is above its signal line, the market is in an uptrend. … On the Hourly (H1) timeframe, take trades only in the direction of the D1 trend. … If D1 shows an uptrend, execute long entries only when the H1 MACD crosses upward. … Ignore short signals entirely. … The analysis begins in December 2018 … Annual return rises to 6.6% (from 4.6%) … maximum drawdown improves from –23.9% to –12.4% … the Sharpe ratio increases from 0.33 to 0.80.
record.notes: MACD(12,26,9) 1h entries filtered by daily MACD trend, BTC Dec 2018-Nov 2025; multi-timeframe test of compiler; base exit is H1 MACD cross down.

spec.claim_summary: Long-only hourly MACD upward-cross entries filtered to take trades only when the daily MACD line is above its signal line.
spec.untestable_reason: The strategy requires filtering hourly MACD entries by the daily MACD line-versus-signal position, which needs synchronized two-timeframe evaluation the single-timeframe spec cannot express.

claimed.other: Annual return rises to 6.6% (from 4.6%); maximum drawdown improves from –23.9% to –12.4%; Sharpe ratio increases from 0.33 to 0.80

assumptions: Asset not named in claim; assumed BTCUSDT from page context as most natural reading.
MACD lengths not stated; used standard 12, 26, 9 for both H1 and D1 legs.
No exit stated; assumed opposite bearish cross as most common reading for MACD-cross setup.
Claim period beginning December 2018 recorded in claimed.period_start; test window is not part of the rule.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: D1 MACD line-above-signal trend filter requiring synchronized D1 plus H1 multi-timeframe evaluation cannot be expressed in the single-timeframe 1h spec, and it is the heart of the claimed filtered strategy.
